program_name: Master of Communications and Media Studies

fees.notes: Monash Malaysia official 2026 fee schedule (international, full course fee); Malaysian RM57,600. 6% service tax applies to international students from 1 Jul 2025. Source: https://www.monash.edu.my/study/postgraduate-and-research/fees

requirements.english_requirement: IELTS 6.5 (no band less than 6.0) or TOEFL iBT 79 or PTE 58
